role: external oracle for wall_resolution's matched coordinates (C1) where golden_gyptis_wide has none: 3D finite-element R, T and mid-plane fields of a metal circle at theta 40 deg (p, s) and at 350 nm with five propagating orders, and of a 130 x 80 nm metal ellipse at theta 20 deg (p, s); the pre-registered criteria of the widened table are asserted against them

references.build: FEniCS (dolfin) 2019.1.0, gmsh 4.15.2, PETSc/petsc4py 3.26.1, MUMPS 5.8.2 (conda-forge), one thread, out of core

modified.description: used through its public Python API; the package itself was not changed

references.settings: Maxwell3DPeriodic on symmetry-reduced cells: at normal incidence a quarter of the cell (x mirrors perfect electric, y mirrors perfect magnetic walls), half the height split into parts even and odd in z (two solves); at phi 0 the whole period in x (Bloch periodic) and half of it in y, z split the same way; over a substrate the quarter cell at full height, one solve with the analytic air/substrate field as the background. s at normal incidence is p on the cell turned by 90 deg. Second-order edge (Nedelec) elements, 400 nm of air and 900 nm of perfectly matched layer above and below. R and T by projecting the periodic part of the scattered field on each diffraction order over an air (or substrate) slab. Relative residuals of the direct solves 2.1e-13 to 1.8e-12. Before the metal cases were read the models were checked against uniform slabs (analytic, within 1.2e-4) and the dielectric block (RETICOLO at order 30, within 1.3e-4); the criterion was 1e-3. The stored phasors are in gyptis's time convention, the conjugate of Wavebit's; the consumer maps them as sign * conj(E), sign -1 for p and +1 for s. An ellipse is a cylinder dilated into a B-spline; its bounds for labelling and refinement come from the surface triangulation. On each ellipse run one mid-plane sample (of 2304), on the domain boundary, missed the cell search by roundoff and takes the nearest cell's value
references.discretization: tetrahedral meshes graded toward the walls and edges, two levels per case (coarser/finer: C1r6p nz 22181/40462 cells; C1a40p oz 42600/79280 cells; C1a40s oz 42600/79280 cells; C1ep oz 43551/82373 cells; C1es oz 43551/82373 cells), the finer with 0.27 to 0.54 million complex unknowns per solve and a smallest edge of about 1.5 nm; the product side is a Fourier truncation of the same cell

generator.command: python fem_sym.py <case> <level> with the mesh rule v2, levels 0 and 1, for each of the five cases; then R and T of the newest record per case and level, and the finer level's plane fields reduced to their in-plane components in single precision

cost.note: the finer level only, five cases; the machine shared its CPU with other work, so the time is not a cost measurement

cells.shapes: a circle of radius 100 nm (C1r6p, C1a40*) or an ellipse with semi-axes 130 nm along x and 80 nm along y (C1e*), centred in the cell
cells.shape_epsilon: -20+1.5j (Wavebit's convention, loss a positive imaginary part; the runs take its conjugate)

incidence.theta_deg: 40 for C1a40*, 20 for C1e*, 0 for C1r6p; phi 0 (plane of incidence xz)
incidence.polarization: the case name's last letter (p or s)
incidence.source: a plane wave from the top

values.R, T: total reflectance and transmittance on the finer mesh level (level 1)
values.R_coarse, T_coarse: the same on the coarser level (level 0)
values.E_<case>: in-plane (Ex, Ey) on each patterned layer's mid-plane, E[plane, j, i, component] at (x[i], y[j]); complex64; gyptis's convention, normalised so the incident wave has phase 0 at the stack's top and x = 0
values.depth_<case>: each plane's depth below the stack's top, top layer first

inputs.mesh_rule: v2 of 2026-11-22: PML 40 nm and air 20 nm elements at every level, refinement at the true edges and on the shapes' walls, top and bottom faces; the two levels differ only in the wall and edge sizes

outcomes.reference_self_check: u_F, the relative R change between the two levels, is 1.7e-04 to 1.7e-03 (above 1e-3, which the criteria call weak, for C1a40p); it is stored with the values
outcomes.failed_or_discarded: the first run of C1ep at the coarser level stopped at the field sampling (the roundoff miss above) and was run again with the nearest-cell fallback

sources.references[0]: the run script, its results file and the run logs, read on 2026-11-24
sources.references[0].independence: the finite-element script imports numpy, dolfin, gmsh, gyptis and a NumPy-only case table
